title: lem-weil-pbc-pullback-iso-nsmul-devissage
statement: For schemes X Y, morphism u : Y ⟶ X, compact and quasi-separated, if for every prime r and every sheaf G with r • 𝟙 G = 0 all maps cohomologyMap u G q are bijective, then for every n > 0 and sheaf G with n • 𝟙 G = 0 all maps cohomologyMap u G q are bijective. Notation and conventions are those of [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], [def-weil-pbc-cohomology-pullback], [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image].

proof.text: Define P(G) as bijectivity in every degree. The pullback long exact ladder and the five lemma establish extension closure in positive degrees; degree zero uses the initial injection and the four lemma.

Apply ObjectProperty.prop_of_nsmul_id_eq_zero to P, the extension closure just established, and hprime. The library theorem handles the n=1 case by the prime 2 and the inductive kernel-image sequence.
